title: Tourism Board Representation in Delhi
tagline: Build an India trade programme from Delhi NCR.
body: Use Delhi NCR as a base for introductions to outbound tour operators, national trade associations and relevant media. Start with bookable experiences, source-market priorities and a calendar for partner training.
deliverable: A Delhi NCR buyer map, trade activity calendar and partner follow-up plan.
question: What should a tourism board prepare for its first Delhi trade meetings?
answer: Bring market-ready itineraries, access and seasonality details, operator contacts and a clear invitation for the buyers you want to activate.

title: International Tourism Marketing in Mumbai
tagline: Put your destination in front of Mumbai travel buyers.
body: Build separate briefs for leisure specialists, luxury advisors and incentive planners. Organise the pitch around connections from Mumbai, the likely trip length and the experiences the trade can quote.
deliverable: A Mumbai account shortlist, destination sales deck and outreach plan.
question: How can a destination prioritise buyers in Mumbai?
answer: Group accounts by traveller segment, itinerary fit and ability to distribute the offer. Confirm the team responsible for quotations and follow-up.

title: Appointing an Airline GSA in Kochi
tagline: Choose a Kochi airline sales partner with a clear mandate.
body: Use a Kochi-specific selection process for a carrier that needs account ownership and passenger servicing defined around COK. Ask bidders to show how they would cover Kerala travel agencies without duplicating existing sales accounts.
deliverable: A Kochi GSA selection checklist, account coverage matrix and first-quarter reporting outline.
question: What should an airline ask a prospective Kochi GSA?
answer: Request examples of agency coverage, ticket servicing boundaries, escalation ownership and a first-quarter sales plan for the routes you want to support.

title: Airline Representation in Surat, Gujarat
tagline: Build airline trade coverage for South Gujarat.
body: Assess Surat travel agencies, business travel desks and group accounts against the carrier’s actual schedules. Compare local departures and surface connections to alternate gateways before developing trade offers.
deliverable: A Surat account plan and an itinerary comparison for the travel trade.
question: How should an airline assess demand from Surat?
answer: Compare route enquiries and agency feedback with actual bookings where available, then test a small account group before expanding coverage.

title: Travel & Tourism SEO Services in India
tagline: Turn itinerary searches into qualified travel enquiries.
body: Map destination research, trip planning and trade buyer queries to pages with distinct jobs. Audit crawlability, internal linking and canonical URLs, then prioritise useful content around available tours, properties and destination information.
deliverable: A keyword-to-page map, technical audit and editorial plan with enquiry tracking.
question: What should a tourism SEO programme measure?
answer: Track qualified enquiries, relevant organic landing pages and whether visitors can reach bookable itineraries or trade contact details. Use Search Console to review actual impressions and clicks.

title: Travel Trade Media Advertising in India
tagline: Reach tour operators, agents and travel buyers in the media they use.
body: Compare trade newsletters, publisher placements, event media and sponsored features by audience role, distribution and creative deadlines. Agree what will be measured before buying placements.
deliverable: A trade media shortlist, buying brief and placement-level enquiry report.
question: How do we compare travel trade advertising placements?
answer: Ask for audience composition, distribution scope, placement dates and link tracking options. Evaluate each placement against qualified responses and attributable trade meetings.
